## Conventional Commits

Please ensure your commits follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) specification:

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `feat:` | A new feature |
| `fix:` | A bug fix |
| `docs:` | Documentation only changes |
| `style:` | Changes that don't affect code meaning (formatting, etc.) |
| `refactor:` | Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature |
| `perf:` | Code change that improves performance |
| `test:` | Adding or correcting tests |
| `chore:` | Changes to build process or auxiliary tools |
| `ci:` | Changes to CI configuration files and scripts |

**Examples:**
- `feat: add PDF lazy loading support`
- `fix: resolve memory leak in texture disposal`
- `docs: update README with new API options`
- `chore: bump dependencies`
